shared_elements: schematic animal-like figure with limbs, seen from the side
incised/outlined figural motif on a rock surface
justification: The only real correspondence is that both surfaces carry a schematic limbed creature rendered as an outline figure, which is about as generic as figural imagery gets. B presents a structured multi-register composition with a row of repeated arch motifs, banded dividers, several distinct animals (long-necked bird, quadrupeds, a snake-like form) stacked in an ordered scheme, whereas A shows a single isolated radiating figure floating alone on the rock with no register, no companions, and no relational scheme at all.
